attchmntText: Amit Spinning Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Girnar Spintex Industries Limited announced the approval of its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, by its Board of Directors on November 14, 2026. The company reported a profit before tax of 3,684.16 lakhs for the quarter and 12,190.86 lakhs for the half year. Total revenue from operations stood at 4,401.09 lakhs for the quarter and 14,902.33 lakhs for the half year. The statutory auditors, Nenawati & Associates, issued a clean Limited Review Report. The company confirmed no defaults on loans or debt securities and stated that related party transactions are not applicable. Managing Director Deepak Choudhari, DIN 03175105, signed the disclosure. The board meeting commenced at 6:00 P.M. and concluded at 9:15 P.M.
